newsitem.title: USA: Miami narrows city manager candidates to two.
newsitem.headline: Miami narrows city manager candidates to two.

text.p: Miami City Commission chose Dade County Finance Director Ed Marquez and North Miami Beach City Manager Mike Roberto late Wednesday as the two finalists in its search for a new city manager.
Marquez, 43, has been the county's finance director since 1987. Roberto, 41, has been North Miami Beach city manager since 1988.
Both said they believed the city's problems, which include a $68 million deficit for the current fiscal year, are "fixable."
Commissioners plan to choose a replacement Friday for City Manager Cesar Odio, who resigned to face federal charges of conspiracy and embezzlement in connection with city contracts.
Acting City Manager Merret Stierheim, a former Dade County manager who now heads the Greater Miami Convention and Visitors Bureau, is expected to step down Nov 15.
